summary: TORM plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing a change in its largest shareholder's ultimate control. Oaktree Capital Group Holdings notified TORM that, following an internal ownership restructuring of OCM Njord Holdings S.à r.l. (Njord Luxco) effective July 31, 2026, Oaktree no longer indirectly holds any TORM shares. Concurrently, Brookfield Corporation became the ultimate controlling shareholder of Njord Luxco, which retains its 20,329,874 Class A shares — 19.86% of TORM's share capital and voting rights. The filing is a major-shareholder notification under Danish capital markets law, not a transaction involving TORM itself. No price, premium, or board action was mentioned. Watch for potential future strategic moves by Brookfield given its new controlling stake in TORM's largest holder.
